title: Morningstar Launches Direct AI with Three AI Agents
key_facts: On 7 Oct 2026 Morningstar launched Direct AI, a redesigned Morningstar Direct platform with AI agents for product development, distribution and manager research; available worldwide.
It is built on Morningstar's data, ratings and the work of more than 1,100 research analysts.
It has a browser-based interface to bring together analysis previously spread across tools or done manually; the first phase has three agents.
The distribution agent can analyse portfolios mixing public and private securities.
Scott Brown, president of the Direct platform, says the quality of the data sets the offering apart.
Morningstar is also making its investment intelligence available through Claude, Microsoft Copilot and ChatGPT.
quote_evidence: On October 7, Morningstar launched Direct AI, a redesigned version of its flagship Morningstar Direct platform that incorporates artificial intelligence agents for product development, distribution, and manager research.
In addition to launching Direct AI, Morningstar is making its investment intelligence available through Claude, Microsoft Copilot, and ChatGPT.
why_it_matters_hint: Investment professionals get AI agents grounded in Morningstar's research, and its research is reachable inside popular chatbots.
notes: Article reads like Morningstar's own announcement; only the distribution agent is described in the text we saw. Event on 7 Oct, before the window, so lowered by 1.
